faq: How much does ElevenLabs cost for voice agents?

ElevenAgents plans: Free is $0 with 15 call minutes a month. Starter is $6/month ($5/month billed yearly) for 75 minutes, Creator $22/month ($18.33 yearly) for 275, Pro $99/month ($82.50 yearly) for 1,238, Scale $299/month ($249.17 yearly) for 3,738 and Business $990/month ($825 yearly) for 12,375. Enterprise is custom.
What do extra call minutes cost?
Additional call minutes cost $0.08 per minute on every plan. Burst pricing, when you go over your concurrency limit, is $0.16 per minute, and text messages cost $0.003 each.
No. LLM usage is billed on top, based on the model you choose. ElevenLabs shows the fee in its platform and deducts it from your ElevenLabs credits.
Does ElevenLabs charge extra for telephony?
No. ElevenLabs adds no telephony fee. If you connect your own provider, such as Twilio or a SIP trunk, that provider bills you directly for its own charges.
